title: The dental vertical AI demo
body: Nobody sells a contact database that says who owns a dental practice, so a sales team in that market has to reconstruct ownership from public signals. I built a go-to-market environment for a vertical AI vendor selling into dental practices. Dental groups are consolidating quickly, with more than 200 new affiliations reported in 2024, and a contact database can still list a practice as independent months after Florida corporate filings show it was acquired. Each prospect is read from ZoomInfo, Apollo, LinkedIn, and a website scrape, and when those four sources disagree an LLM reconciles them against Florida Sunbiz filings and scores a verdict on the parent company. The accounts are invented; the enrichment waterfall that processes them is real code running on this site.
signals: Ownership reconstructed from ZoomInfo, Apollo, LinkedIn, and Florida Sunbiz
LLM arbitrates conflicting sources into a parent-company verdict
Seeded Postgres, running live on this site
